scope: Post-output reverse hurdles, not adopted forecasts or observed economics. Preserve frozen base. All changes begin2031, so end2030 treasury, claim count and prior cash are fixed.

investment_reduction_only.interpretation: Multiply each post2030 net growth investment including WC by this fraction while keeping operating profit, D&A, revenue, financing and terminal growth unchanged. It scales productivity across the transition too. This tests capital efficiency at fixed output, not a free cancellation of gross equipment replacement or a proved achievable factory program.

extra_cash_only.interpretation: No extra reinvestment, working capital, minority claims or debt assumed for the added cash. This is an optimistic conversion hurdle, not a funded external Foundry valuation.

professional_counterview.author: Brian Colello
professional_counterview.summary: Morningstar cut value for PC weakness and recognizes server growth plus manufacturing/substrate constraints. Its published conclusion is modest undervaluation.
professional_counterview.comparison_limit: Their current fair-value estimate differs in date from our end2030 conditional exit. Our end2026 reference is31.61, but it too is not exact November fair value. Public excerpt does not disclose a matched complete cash/capital model. Do not attribute the gap to any one Morningstar assumption or call this market consensus.

rate_only_reverse_hurdle.interpretation: Reverse-implied rate, not adopted WACC/required return or evidence risk will fall. All operating cash and claims fixed.

joint_diagnostic_limit: 0.8 and1.0 are illustrative capital-productivity controls, not separately researched alternative forecasts. Each uniformly scales post2030 net investment relative to the adopted phased path; all revenues, margins, terminal growth and shares remain fixed. Joint improvements can erase a gap even if any one-variable threshold looks demanding.

external_program_cash_hurdle_addendum.purpose: Size the omitted external-business risk in net cash terms; not value a contract, assign probabilities or revise either stock estimate.
external_program_cash_hurdle_addendum.formula: Additional end2030 equity = net incremental2031aftertaxcash/(.12-.03); divide by5.51Bclaims. Only applies when the netcash stream already pays all incremental replacement/growth capital, WC, tax, lease and minority claims.
external_program_cash_hurdle_addendum.cash_definition: Net NEW shareholder-attributable unlevered cash, not revenue, EBITDA or gross profit. Exclude any already modeled service/product cash. No separate free credit for internal transfers or existing model expenditure.
external_program_cash_hurdle_addendum.upfront_cost_rule: The reported hurdle assumes no additional unmodeled pre2031outlay/claim change. Every1Bnetextra end2030equitycost raises required2031cash by0.09B at these fixedrates; actual earlier funding, newdebt/dilution or covenants require paired cash/claims modeling.
external_program_cash_hurdle_addendum.interpretation: The central case has materially more headroom than the faster case. This does not demonstrate that either amount is impossible or likely. A large positive-NPV external program can invalidate the short; absence of disclosed terms is not proof of zero value.
